scope.complete: temper-drc-rs default DrcRule registry plus its unregistered PowerDomainCheck; seven maintained Zapote unit report rule censuses
scope.bounded: 16 supplementary Rust donor surfaces reviewed for next ports; public-module discovery for five crates
scope.excluded: No claim of exhaustive firmware, all legacy Python validators, every optimizer/router helper or all CI consumers. No hardware qualification.

counting: Rule implementations, recorded rule IDs, object populations, test cases and physical qualification are separate; 228 prior workspace tests is not 228 PCB rules.

registry.execution_status: static registration census; donor run_all not executed in this audit

donor_rules.actual_scope: Component-body distance by net class, not every copper pair.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: RTD has custom geometry checks; no equivalent whole-unit body-spacing pass for PFC.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Use native bodies and explicit net/domain constraints; retain copper clearance separately.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Same-side component-body overlap.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: Native KiCad checks complement Zapote; no generic Zapote body collision gate.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Prefer the stricter temper-geometry body_collision kernel, with supported pose and body census.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Expanded component bounding boxes, not an exact KiCad courtyard audit.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: No generic copied rule.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Bind actual courtyard polygons and selected assembly clearance; do not adopt the 0.05 mm default blindly.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Same-layer trace-pair clearance using net-class constraints.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: Zapote native_clearance checks copper with the copied Temper clearance kernel.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Preserve current kernel; compare fault coverage before copying another trace-pair implementation.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Via edge gap with pad-size-dependent floor.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: Zapote copper clearance overlaps different-net spacing, not the full same-net fabrication rule.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Use a selected fabrication envelope for drill and same-net spacing.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Component-center membership in declared zone classes.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: RTD authored-region checks cover a different scope.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Review center-only limitation and exact zone association before port.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Noisy component membership in declared ground regions; not proof of continuous return copper.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: RTD has return checks; other units have unequal coverage.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Validate actual filled return geometry and distinguish quiet ground from high-current return.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Bounding-box area of components on critical nets; not the actual switching-current loop.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: Bypass locality exists on several units; PFC report has no loop-area check.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Retain as a labeled screening heuristic; use actual commutation-path geometry for a stronger obligation.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Aggressor/victim component-distance screen.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: RTD sensitive-aggressor checks are unit-specific.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Supply explicit aggressors/victims and meaningful noise constraints instead of assuming names classify all nets.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Warns about whole components absent from all nets; does not inspect every pin.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: Exact unit component/pin censuses cover reviewed circuits, not a generic pin-type ERC engine.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Add generic pin-role and intentional-NC coverage using real package pins; preserve donor orphan-component cases.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Counts connected components per net; fewer than two is an error. Does not establish physical continuity.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: Zapote unit contracts check exact pin/net graphs and native connectivity.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Reuse relevant fault cases; do not replace pin/copper checks with a component count.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Always returns an empty result and is deliberately unregistered.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: Zapote has authored domain geometry and exact circuit contracts, not generic voltage compatibility.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Do not copy the stub. Define voltage domains and allowed isolation crossings; then implement fail-closed compatibility.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Thermal placement spacing and edge constraints.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: No generic Zapote port.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Copy with exact thermal-constraint schema and measured/model-bounded loss inputs.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Power-based via-count screen; empty via input can skip evaluation.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: No general Zapote thermal-via or junction-temperature gate.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Require power and heat-path data, reject missing required vias, and avoid treating count as a temperature prediction.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Bottom-side SMD to THT spacing screen.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: No generic Zapote port.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Apply only to the selected assembly process; otherwise record reasoned not-applicable.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Zone inset from rectangular board bounds.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: Native DRC supplements units; no common Zapote arbitrary-outline copper containment gate.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Use saved Edge.Cuts and all copper shapes, including arcs and cutouts.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Trace and filled-zone intersection/distance against layer-scoped barrier polylines.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: Current domain spacing does not assert a required physical barrier exists.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: High-value donor port; supply barriers, require applicable object census, and add pad/via coverage.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Slot/isolation-named zone bounding dimensions, not an actual milled-slot path proof.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: No general Rust slot geometry qualification.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Bind actual Edge.Cuts slots and reviewed surface-path rules; do not count copper-zone names as slots.

donor_rules.actual_scope: >=20 A selector and 60% component-dimension proxy at trace endpoints.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: No full-current path/neckdown gate in PFC; 15 A input could evade donor selection.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Derive per-path RMS/peak current, use real pads, and test production 15 A-class inputs.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Parallel trace-run screen for configured noise domains.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: No generic Zapote port.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Use explicit aggressor/victim nets and validate angular/overlap boundary cases.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Inner-layer HV spacing multiplier, not a physical partial-discharge model.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: PFC is two-layer; no inner-copper population there. Other multilayer units need explicit HV applicability.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Keep material/insulation assumptions explicit; absence of inner layers is a reasoned scope exclusion, not a universal pass.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Uses component-edge and component-dimension proxies for pad entry on >=5 A nets.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: No full-current path/neckdown gate in PFC.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Do not copy the proxy as ampacity proof; adapt to real pad copper and current-path bounds.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Name-selected fast nets and declared ground-zone crossing screen.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: RTD return checks overlap intent; no universal Zapote gate.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Use explicit signal/return pairing and native fill geometry, not only name substrings.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Ground-via spacing heuristic with name-based selection and empty-population exits.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: RTD return stitching is a separate unit-specific contract.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Require authored return nets and via coverage; missing required vias must not be an empty pass.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Emits a reminder for low-current THT components; does not measure relief spokes.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: No generic Zapote relief-spoke validator.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Use actual pad-to-fill spoke geometry; an informational reminder is not a passing manufacturing check.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Isolation-component package-size sanity only; no conductor surface-path measurement.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: No general Rust surface-path creepage qualification in the reviewed unit reports.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Do not promote this to creepage coverage. Audit req_safe_01 and creepage_check kernels and native creepage evidence separately.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Component-body HV/LV separation by class.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: Zapote current-sense and gate-drive use copper-domain spacing; PFC uses a net voltage profile.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Keep native copper checks; add exhaustive authored domain membership and cross-unit interface obligations.

donor_rules.actual_scope: Declared isolation-zone occupancy restrictions for component bodies.
donor_rules.zapote_overlap: Unit separation checks are not a generic barrier-occupancy gate.
donor_rules.transfer_decision: Port after authored boundaries, allowed devices and input populations are explicit.
